flags.text: Landen was actually working overtime as gsd/chef this morning, he was the fairy going through the stand spreading good mood pixie dust. On the other hand we had levels 1-10 of grump exuding off of the inside crew because FOR SOME REASON(clearly not the fact that I asked them minimum 14 times to read back their orders) we were remaking damn near every other order at window. i LOVE that both runners had enough energy to irritate the entire inside of the stand but not enough energy to hand out stickers, double save orders, read back orders, get orders right?? bare minimum to just do their job as line busters. Asking both Megan and Daphne to fulfill and follow through with these tasks is actually comparable to pulling teeth, hearding cats, talking to a brick wall, you name it. And after having to ask all morning to follow through on basic tasks I got met with eye rolls and deep sighs…oh actually we started pettily putting  “got stickers read back order” in the comment section of each order and as much as I LOVE the idea of that.. it actually doesn’t work when we’re still getting the orders wrong and even sending an online order for ANTELOPE to the window with that comment attached. Cherry on top is between Ethan telling Megan she can’t sit on shift and instead going outside to sit behind the big green box OR both runners standing by the expo door doing nothing while everyone else is busting ass and when I said “it’s fine if you guys are in here but you need to be doing something” and both of them looking at each other and silently walking out expo door to go stand outside and do nothing.
Tardy/early-out note: Megan was late, mady went home 30 mins early

Xbro was great other than half of our orders at window being out of order or just straight up so wrong and throwing our average out the window…but every person inside was on top of it and super talkative and helpful
Hazard reported: We don’t have a lot of chocolate milk left, the alarm is being weird again??
I apologize for the long recap today was just a very frustrating day-ask ethan.
